GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

5. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   B. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   B. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   C. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   C. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.

10. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   D. Treat Fishing as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   D. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. D — Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
